about: Latest live state of the Canary Wharf / Docklands zone and the last 24 hours, written by cwplans/tools/cache-londat.mjs (danbri/londat) from the history in this folder. Times: ISO UTC. Each theme keeps the licence of its source (sources).
history: cache/runs/2026-10-DD/live-*.json.gz (this month, one file per run); cache/live-YYYY-MM.sqlite (closed months)

rows: Central Line: Minor delays due to train cancellations.
Northern Line: Minor delays due to an earlier signal failure at Balham.
Piccadilly Line: Minor delays between Acton Town and Uxbridge / Heathrow Terminals due to an earlier signalling problem at Hammersmith. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.
SUFFRAGETTE LINE: No service between South Tottenham and Barking Riverside until further notice. Please use local London Underground and London Buses services.

Suffragette Line: No service between South Tottenham and Barking Riverside due to a operational incident. MINOR DELAYS on the rest of the line. London Underground accepting tickets via any reasonable routes. Disruption expected until the end of the week.
